cards.name: The Borg Queen
cards.oracle_text:
Artifact creatures you control get +2/+2.
Whenever The Borg Queen enters or attacks, target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a creature card. Assimilate that card. They put the rest on the bottom in a random order. (To assimilate a card, put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)

cards.name: Commander Spock
cards.oracle_text: Strange new worlds — Whenever Commander Spock enters or attacks, reveal the top card of your library. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost if that spell's mana value is equal to or less than the number of differently named lands you control. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If that card is still on top of your library, draw a card.

cards.name: Jean-Luc Picard, Luminary
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever another historic permanent you control with mana value 3 or greater enters, draw a card. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
Seek out — Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one other target creature and two charge counters on up to one target Spacecraft.

cards.name: Worf, Defiant Commander
cards.oracle_text:

cards.oracle_text:
Geordi La Forge can't be blocked if you control a Spacecraft.
Whenever Geordi La Forge deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
